name: exposed.tech
tagline: Scan a food label and meet each ingredient as a character, with pros, cons and dangerous combinations.

awards: Hack with the Best Startup Potential by Morrissette

problem: Nutrition labels are technical and hard to understand.
solution: A mobile app extracts compounds from a label photo, explains each one's health effects, flags bad combinations and allergens, and presents ingredients as visual personalities.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan a drink can and see its ingredients 'exposed'.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Hack with the Best Startup Potential by Morrissette” among 82 submissions.
Makes ingredient analysis playful rather than dry.

lessons: Personality and play can turn a utility into something people want to open.
